messages:
anya: thinking about postmortem followups 1: we keep losing momentum on remediation owners. proposal: set a clear remediation SLO, small ticket template, automatic reminders, and a rotation tweak. want a quick pilot.

frank: high-level sounds good. what's the SLO you have in mind?

anya: proposed SLOs: P1 customer-impact remediations = 14 days to resolution; P2 = 30 days; low-impact = 90 days. if a remediation is >50% into SLO and not verified, it auto-escalates.

devon: +1 to SLOs. suggest we also track a "verification window": once resolved, owner has 7 days to provide verification evidence (metrics, canary link, runbook update) or it reopens.

anya: exactly. also suggest a tiny JIRA template so people don't leave out important fields and a recurrence flag if same component recurs. minimal template idea below.

```
Remediation Ticket Template:
- Summary: short
- Component(s): list
- Priority (P1/P2/P3)
- Owner: @name
- Target SLO: 14d / 30d / 90d
- Acceptance: how we'll verify (link)
- Recurrence flag: yes/no + evidence (link to similar incidents)
- Blockers: short bullets
- Next action + ETA
```

ops-bot: i can create a reminder flow: `@ops-bot schedule <jira-id> 50%SLO verifyDue escalateTo:oncall-lead` -> sends nudges at the configured threshold and posts verification reminders. ops-team needs to enable jira integration.

frank: for dashboards we should expose three KPIs: remediation MTTR, reopen rate, and repeat-component count (90d). a simple heatmap widget for components would help focus engineering time.

devon: agree. we can tag incidents with component and automation can increment repeat counts. if repeat-component >= 3 in 90d then auto-create a "root cause review" card and ping the oncall lead.

oncall-lead: can we avoid weekly IC swaps? swapping too often fragments context. propose 2-week IC slots (Mon 09:00 UTC start) so owner has time to shepherd remediations. still keep a visible roster in the playbook.

anya: 2-week slots works for me. we'll keep a secondary contact for weekends but primary IC owns followups during their slot.

devon: small note: add a "blocked twice -> auto-escalate" rule. if owner marks blocked in two consecutive check-ins, escalate to oncall-lead and open a short incident to remove blockers.

frank: operationally we need a tiny weekly digest to review active remediations (max 10) and flag repeats. suggest ops-bot posts a digest every Monday with status counts.

ops-bot: can do: `@ops-bot digest weekly #eng-oncall monday 09:15 UTC active-remediations` -> includes links and overdue counts.

anya: plan: i'll draft a playbook PR with the SLOs, ticket template, auto-escalation rules, and the ops-bot commands for a 2-week pilot. @oncall-lead can you run the pilot and collect 2-week feedback?

oncall-lead: happy to run pilot. i'll set up a 30-min review at the end of week 2 to collect feedback and check dashboard signals.

devon: i'll work with analytics to expose the three KPIs and add a repeat-component alert threshold.

frank: i'll check with platform team about tagging hygiene and jira integration.

anya: great. i'll open the PR by EOD and tag you all. if no objections in 24h we'll merge to run the 2-week pilot. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: tip: use `@ops-bot preview <jira-id>` to see the scheduled reminders before enabling.

anya: thanks everyone 1 — goal is fewer orphaned remediations and faster detection of recurring failure modes.
